__comment: Dwarven Bed - independently buildable single bed (art doc 40, 2026-10-01).
Approved footprint: 4 blocks long on X, 2 wide on Z; headboard at local -X.
Mattress top is 1 block high, pillow/folded blanket 1.25, headboard 2.
Collision regions use footprint-local coordinates; offset boxes rotate with the model.
Bed assignment, walking to bed and sleep animation remain future gameplay work.
description: A heavy oak bed with a linen-covered straw mattress, broad pillow and folded blanket.
